coverage_note: Building permits processed by Marin County (Community Development Agency) — the county's own permitting jurisdiction, including unincorporated Marin and the county-served areas inside its cities and towns. Marin's incorporated cities also run their own permit counters for work outside the county's jurisdiction; those permits are not in this feed.

dedupe_rule.definition: One published permit = one permit_number in Marin County's Building Permit dataset. The dataset's grain is one row per permit: no collapsing applies or is needed.
dedupe_rule.measurement: Trailing-12-month window (issued_date >= 2025-11-16), measured 2026-11-16 on the full paged pull saved as audit evidence: 4,204 rows = 4,204 distinct permit_number = 4,204 distinct permit_tracking_id, 0 duplicates. The pipeline's in-batch duplicate gate and the (county_id, source_record_id) upsert key guard every future pull.

field_map.address: address, as published (the full street address; the trailing ', CITY, CA ZIP' suffix the field repeats is stripped at normalization since city and ZIP are carried in their own fields; present on 4,204 of 4,204 window permits; title-cased at normalization).
field_map.application_date: received_date (the date the county received the application; published on all 4,204 window permits).
field_map.category: type_permit, the county's own class: RESIDENTIAL = Residential (3,948 window permits), COMMERCIAL = Commercial (256).
field_map.contractor_rule: contractor, the county's published contractor of record (present on 4,158 of 4,204 window permits). Sampled 55 names at audit: all are business names (firms, LLCs, INCs) or the county's own OWNER / OWNER/BUILDER tokens, which mark an owner-built permit — the tokens are stored as NULL because an owner is not a contractor business. No applicant or property-owner field is requested at all.
field_map.issue_date: issued_date. The window is defined on it: rows without an issued date are applications the county has not issued and stay outside the window by construction (2,726 all-time rows carry no issued date).
field_map.permit_number: permit_number — verified exactly unique in the trailing-12-month window (4,204 distinct = 4,204 rows, 2026-11-16 audit). permit_tracking_id is equally unique and is carried in the pull for the identity cross-check.
field_map.permit_type_source: permit_category, the county's own work category (Maintenance 2,832 / All other Construction 699 / Minor Improvement 673 in the window). The dataset's permit_work_class field is an internal department-routing list and is never requested.
field_map.project_description: description where the county publishes one (1,442 of 4,204 window permits); otherwise the county's own construction component list (e.g. 'ReRoofing; With Electronic Inspection'), which is the scope statement it publishes for its on-demand permits; otherwise its fee_code_title. 541 window permits publish none of the three and carry no description.
field_map.status_source: The dataset publishes no status field; a row enters the window only by carrying an issued date, so status is 'issued' for every record by construction; status_source stays NULL.
field_map.valuation: construction_value, the county's stated construction value. PASSED validation on the full window (2026-11-16): stated on 100% of window permits (0 null; $0 on 30; $1 on 4; none negative); total $296,368,535; median positive value computed at build. Same-address + same-value groups above $10k bound any restatement excess at $584,172 = 0.2% of the total. The largest permit ($39,518,511, a major remodel of the Golden Gate Village housing complex in Sausalito, stated once) is 13.3% of the total — one real, named project whose full scope text prints alongside. Values publish as reported.

history_range: 51,653 rows at audit (permits from January 1, 2014 to present per the dataset description); we backfill the trailing 12 months only (site rule).
license: Marin County open-data portal (public reuse with attribution); attribution: County of Marin, California
rate_limit: Socrata anonymous tier; paged pulls with polite pacing.
source_name: Marin County open data — Building Permit (Community Development Agency)
terms_status: verified-open-2026-11-16: the dataset is published by Marin County on its official open-data portal (data.marincounty.gov) for public reuse; figures are published 'as reported by Marin County' with attribution; no endorsement is implied.
update_cadence: Daily (the dataset description's own stated cadence; MEASURED 2026-11-16: rowsUpdatedAt 2026-11-16T08:31:18Z, same day as the audit, and newest issued_date 2026-11-14). Freshness (gate 5) is measured as the dataset's rowsUpdatedAt under a 48h threshold (the Socrata-county standard).
watermark_field: issued_date + permit_number — refresh re-pulls by the issued_date watermark and upserts.
